steps.heading: Prepare the canvas
steps.caption: Start with your printed 8 x 10 canvas. Protect your table. Use thin coats; rinse and blot brushes between colors.

steps.heading: Set the atmosphere
steps.caption: Mix blue, a speck of black and white for a smoky sky. Paint around every outline; leave the shapes white.

steps.heading: Ground & moonlight
steps.caption: Mix brown, a speck of black and a little white for ground. Use white + a little yellow for the moon; paint bats black.

steps.heading: Block in the plum
steps.caption: Mix red and blue with a touch of brown for plum. Paint the hat, brim and coat; keep the band and buckle white.

steps.heading: Add the autumn color
steps.caption: Mix yellow, a little red and a touch of brown for russet orange. Paint pumpkins and band, including buckle center. Leave faces and stems white.

steps.heading: Nose & leather shoes
steps.caption: For peach, mix white, a little yellow and a tiny touch of red. Paint the nose peach and shoes brown.

steps.heading: Shape the beard
steps.caption: Paint beard and mustache white. Mix white with a speck of black and brown for warm gray; pull curved strokes toward the tips.

steps.heading: Finish the base colors
steps.caption: Mix green with a touch of brown for stems. Mix yellow with a touch of brown for the buckle rim. Let dry.

steps.heading: Build depth
steps.caption: Mix red, blue, brown and a speck of black for hat shadows. Mix yellow, a little red and extra brown for pumpkin grooves. Blend softly.

steps.heading: Define the lanterns
steps.caption: Over dry paint, fill the pumpkins' printed eyes and mouths with black using a small brush. Keep the edges controlled.

steps.heading: Catch the light
steps.caption: Mix white with a little yellow for ivory. Add fine, curved highlights to the beard and small shine strokes to the shoes.

steps.heading: Dry & care for tools
steps.caption: Let your canvas dry lying flat. Wash and reshape brushes, wipe the palette and close your paint pots.

referenceRestoration.method: Deterministic canonical crops; removed old drawn brush cues. Step 9 combines a finished-reference hat/fold crop with a resized stage-09 pumpkin-groove crop, without a heavy inset outline or premature black face fill.

inset.note: Canonical step-09 pumpkin grooves; face interiors remain white until step 10.
